Changes:
0: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Device Sync Reassurance Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly inform users that signing in ensures cloud saving and pet sync across sessions. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again on another device or reinstalling.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Compact Pet Picker Grid Layout: Redesign the pick_friend selection stage into a compact layout with structured pet choice cards. (why: Adoption stage has a 74.5% conversion with a high mean time of 1017s, indicating hesitation during pet selection.)
2: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Option Overview Screen: Add a dedicated path intro screen before path choice to explain preset vs custom pet creation options clearly. (why: choose_path has an 8s median but 514s mean time, showing some users stall when choosing between creation paths.)
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Render Verification Diagnostics: Insert a desktop overlay verification screen after waiting to confirm app render permission and window overlay status. (why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to appear on the desktop or the app stalling on launch, and home mean time is 2336s.)
4: [finish, redesign] Stage Layout Desktop Control Guide: Redesign the home_intro finish screen into a stage layout featuring an animated mascot previewing core desktop controls. (why: Finish completion drops to 68.7% with a massive mean time of 5815s, and 3 users reported confusion over controlling or hiding pets.)
5: [adoption, layout] Photo Upload Quality Checklist Layout: Change upload_photos layout to checklist style with clear guidelines for best AI pet generation results. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results.)
6: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Certificate: Move sign-in screen to after adoption certificate creation to increase user commitment before requiring an account. (why: Sign-in is an early barrier. Moving it right after pet creation leverages attachment to complete authentication.)
7: [home, wait_info] Unpacking Progress Component on Waiting Screen: Add an asset extraction progress bar component to the waiting screen to indicate active setup progress. (why: Home wait median is 201s (mean 2336s), leaving users uncertain if the engine setup has frozen.)
8: [choose_path, copy] Story Value Proposition Copy Refresh: Update the initial story screen headline and body copy to clearly highlight immediate desktop companionship benefits. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at the choose_path stage.)
9: [finish, hint] System Tray Shortcut Hint on Finish: Add an explicit hint on the home_intro screen telling users how to summon or minimize their pet via system shortcuts. (why: 3 support messages highlighted post-onboarding confusion on how to hide or talk to the pet.)
